name: A permanent magnet can be effectively made from which of the following materials?
description:
Question:

A permanent magnet can be effectively made from which of the following materials?

(a) Steel / Alnico
(b) Soft Iron
(c) Copper
(d) Aluminum

Answer: (a) Steel / Alnico ✅

Concept:

Permanent Magnet ke liye aisa material chahiye
jo magnetism ko lambe samay tak banaye rakhe.

Steel aur Alnico ki Retentivity aur Coercivity zyada hoti hai,
isliye ye Permanent Magnet banane ke liye use hote hain.

Soft Iron ki Retentivity kam hoti hai,
isliye use Electromagnet banane ke liye use karte hain.

TRICK:

Permanent Magnet → Steel / Alnico

Electromagnet → Soft Iron

Yaad Rakhne Ki Line:

"Permanent ko Steel pasand,
Temporary ko Soft Iron pasand."

Important MCQs:

Permanent Magnet → Steel, Alnico

Electromagnet → Soft Iron

Strong Permanent Magnet → Alnico

Temporary Magnet → Soft Iron
